events.title: Oasis's Debut Album Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' in 1994.

angles.name: Album Impact
angles.copy: Thirty-two years since Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music. What's your standout track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place in 1969, defining a generation.

angles.name: Defining Festival
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, Woodstock brought together half a million people for 'three days of peace and music'. Which act would you have loved to see live?

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock 'n' Roll, passed away on this day in 1977; he would have been 91.

angles.name: King's Legacy
angles.copy: Still the King. Remembering Elvis Presley, who would have been 91 today, and his unparalleled legacy in music.

events.title: Remembering Tupac Shakur
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996; he would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Influence
angles.copy: Thirty years since we lost a voice that defined a generation. Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 today, and his enduring impact.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died on this day in 1970; he would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Remembering the visionary Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84 today. His guitar work continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' in 1969, featuring that famous zebra crossing.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road' and arguably the most famous album cover in history. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Icon Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the one and only Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, still commanding the stage.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Oasis frontman and rock 'n' roll star Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Mad Fer It Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis anthem?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his timeless and poignant single 'Imagine' in 1975.

angles.name: Song of Hope
angles.copy: Fifty-one years since John Lennon released 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates with its powerful message of peace and unity.

events.title: The Original iPod Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first-generation iPod in 2001, revolutionising how we listen to music.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember your first iPod? Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original, changing portable music forever. How many songs could yours hold?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 007 first hit the big screen. Who's your favourite Bond and what's the best theme song?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary musician and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire generations.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Comedy legend John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Genius
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite moment from a true comedy icon?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: Experimental Masterpiece
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles dropped the 'White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate. What's your top track from it?
